brief_description: PicoRV32 RISC-V CPU 'ez' (easy) testbench output, kept as raw VCD to exercise the parser's VCD path. Small SoC trace covering instruction fetch, memory read/write, and a tight counter loop on the test firmware. Built locally: iverilog -o testbench_ez.vvp testbench_ez.v picorv32.v && vvp testbench_ez.vvp +vcd.
anchors: child scope `testbench.uut` is the picorv32 core instance
signal `trap` should remain 0 throughout the trace
